verdict.rationale: The Department of State does provide copies of a filer's own records. Online filers receive their filing receipt as a PDF, and plain or certified copies of filed documents can be requested as PDF attachments, which is an open document format. There is no evidence of a self-serve bulk export of all entity data in machine-readable formats, and no evidenced exit path. The online filing host also blocked agent access. Missing for 10: bulk self-serve export of all entity records, machine-readable formats (CSV/JSON/API), documented exit/dissolution or transfer path, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
